# Launch checklist (maintainer notes)

**Description (repo "About", 350 chars max):**
Budget-aware model router for Hermes Agent. Picks the cheapest model that fits each task before the session starts, tracks monthly spend, and works with Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, OpenRouter or local models. Includes the fix for "You're out of extra usage" on Claude Max/Ultra API credits.

**Website:** link to the Substack post once published.

**Topics:** hermes-agent, llm, ai-agents, model-routing, cost-optimization, claude, anthropic, openai, gemini, grok, ollama, llmops, finops, cli, python

**Social preview:** Settings → General → Social preview → upload `docs/img/social-preview.png`

**Release:** tag `v0.3.0`, title "v0.3.0: first public release", body = `.github/RELEASE_NOTES_v0.3.0.md`

**Settings:** enable Issues and Discussions. Disable Wiki and Projects. Labels: `setup-report`, `bug`, `preset`, `good first issue`.

**Pinned issue:** "Setup reports wanted: which presets work for you?" (links the template)
